goal: Implement the Phase 2 harness runner, state/fingerprint/scope modules, GitNexus adapter stub, and CI skeleton so docs-only tasks can be verified deterministically.

acceptanceCriteria.text: harness.ps1 exposes doctor/start/verify/status/resume/finish and returns explicit exit codes.
Task state transitions follow contract: draft→ready→implementing→verifying→reviewing→done; blocked carries reason/resumeFrom.
Fingerprint covers tracked/staged/deleted/renamed/untracked and unborn HEAD; edits between verify and finish mark evidence stale.
Scope selector runs only applicable gates; uninitialized modules produce not_applicable with reason, never fake pass.
GitNexus adapter detects availability and falls back to targeted-search with an explicit impact note.
Runner unit tests cover failure modes: nonzero exit, timeout, missing gate, stale evidence, uninitialized-module bypass attempt.
CI workflow invokes the same runner config as local with least-privilege token; no deploy or publish steps.

nextAction: Phase 3: resume/orchestration drill, GitNexus live test on bootstrapped backend, evidence freshness across sessions. P1 cwd-allowlist bug fixed and verified (sibling-dir bypass blocked).
